name: Can I convert my existing tub into a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my existing tub into a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting an existing tub into a walk-in shower is a common and feasible upgrade, especially beneficial for enhancing accessibility and modernizing a bathroom. This type of conversion often involves removing the tub, reconfiguring plumbing, and installing a new shower pan, wall surrounds, and fixtures. The feasibility and complexity can depend on your existing bathroom layout and plumbing. We can assess your space to determine the best approach for a tub-to-shower conversion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Converting a tub to a walk-in shower is feasible, improving accessibility and modernizing the bathroom. It involves removing the tub and reconfiguring plumbing, with feasibility depending on layout.
